title: Create miner.py — friction signal detection from transcripts
acceptance_criteria: detect_rephrasing(transcript) → list[dict]: finds repeated phrases within edit distance
detect_rapid_edits(transcript) → list[dict]: finds clusters of edits within short window
detect_retries(transcript) → list[dict]: finds retry patterns (user restating same request)
compute_friction_score(signals) → dict with overall score 0.0-1.0 and signal_breakdown
extract_friction_signals(transcript) → Result[list[dict], Err]: orchestrator combining all detectors
Very short transcript (<10 words) → Ok([]) gracefully
All functions pure: no I/O, same input = same output
